title: Replication Package: Asymmetric effects of real exchange rate movements on domestic value added in Mexican exports
description: Replication package containing full empirical datasets, ANN-MIDAS machine learning disaggregation pipelines, NARDL econometric estimation scripts, and dynamic multiplier outputs supporting the CIDE Master's Thesis: 'Asymmetric effects of real exchange rate movements on domestic value added in Mexican exports' by Bertin Yair Acosta Bautista (2026).

creators.name: Acosta Bautista, Bertin Yair
creators.affiliation: Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas (CIDE)
